## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Complete the first production-to-native vertical slice using actual action resolution evidence.

**Scope:** Pinned Korangar synthetic Walk playback, exact-slot traces, transformed regressions and separately scoped acceptance packet.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Native evidence pins executable/source identity, installed artifact hashes/path, requested Walk/view, resolved numeric ACT slot, observed frame/layer sequence and fallback status.
- [x] Standard reachable native action views resolve exactly; ASSET_LOADED, fallback/modulo or screenshots without selection proof cannot satisfy REQUESTED_ACTION_VERIFIED.
- [x] Complete declared checklist → supplied PNG → explicit composition approval → deterministic compile → Rust decode → native exact-Walk chain; scope/full-profile/visual/native results remain separate.
- [x] Narrow harness-only scope may be diagnostic but cannot receive full-profile production or native-verified claims when runtime falls back.
- [x] Record native/operator decision and any failed/unrun gates; suspected codec/slot defect requires correction before relying on output. M5 needs its own proof even if M0-N passed.

## Verification

Run pinned exact-action harness with independent inspectable traces/captures and compare installed hashes; repeat relevant multilayer regressions; environment blockers remain NATIVE_UNVERIFIED.

Actual commands, environment, artifact hashes, exit statuses and explicit NOT_RUN items are preserved in docs/verification/rsf-27/VERIFICATION.md, commands.json, reproduction-commands.json and QA_REVIEW.md. Claims are bounded to the recorded native engineering scope; no real-art approval is granted.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-26 (M5-04; task ID tju1c32n1jrxitklr5hnj6la)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Reuse M0-06 evidence recipe/build selection as context, not proof for changed artifacts; no upstream modifications.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- Scope: reuse RSF-6 pinned native corridor; actual loaded hashes, native selection, native texture upload observations, GPU captures and negative controls. No production compiler, codec, oracle or upstream checkout changes.
- Changed existing paths: tools/korangar-native/main.rs, prepare.py, README.md. Added walk.rs, walk_fixture.py, verify_walk.py, walk_controls.py, test_walk_verifier.py and docs/verification/rsf-27 evidence/reproduction.
- Manifest: docs/verification/rsf-27/implementation-manifest.json SHA-256 09158eb6674dc68b54128452d5d66f098fe675d4e612ed752173025a5123939e; bounded diff and146-file baseline:143 unchanged.
- Pinned Korangar: 3f3d88a583203f09d079712f43343c1041258ffd. Executable SHA-256 27986612b7cb3af691f6f0b2853721d03c11089e66bdc921ee9d460f441f391d, isolated stage /tmp/rsf27-native-sealed.
- Modified ACT SHA-256 43fffe83c1333772126a51e171a5d33d3b03ab1706f670f869099b1633b7617b; SPR 0d49b375c22b5cd738c8a448d564409e4bfdbf90a1a6593a62ec4db3756a6a81; canonical build-manifest bytes 3a7832608569ed9248bf42e1d3f0274ba0548937c76897e3450918aa219d1bd1.
- Native:176 cases;1060 prepared frames/2796 layers;1080 selected frames/4144 drawn layers;56 captures;3 targeted occurrences;196 preserved samples;zero mandatory mismatches. All8Walkviews exact (slots8–15), both camera directions; no positive fallback.
- Native report SHA-256 af20687d42dcd9dda8bc9b9288daf81b498723e9676837f666009bf1a6db46c5; independent/coordinator repeated reports and56 captures byte-identical on llvmpipe/Vulkan.
- Automated checks: public452PASS; private40PASS+1existing legacy skip; independent Rust11PASS; native Rust4PASS; checker17PASS;10schema checkersPASS; isolated distribution443PASS+9optional skips. Actual commands/statuses retained; expected invalid native controls exit101.
-17negative controls detect wrong original pair, wrong ACT, missing mounts/files, hash/frame/action/pool defects and tampered/missing evidence. Originals/staged sources remain immutable; private assets/captures excluded.
- Classification remains PARTIAL_DIAGNOSTIC, production false. Load/selection/rendering LevelsA–C PASS; LevelD reference pixel parity UNVERIFIED. HardwareGPU, ordinary gameplay and audible sound untested; Python3.12/3.13 and rustfmt unavailable NOT_RUN; browserNOT_RUN(noUIchanges).

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

QA_PASS — repository-configured forge_qa_reviewer (/root/rsf24_qa), separate read-only context. All five live criteria independently verified. Durable QA_REVIEW.md SHA-256 1afb8beb1536954d5262b75969ec472a2dc30291b1ec75b25b728be3d9edb5a5. Reviewer independently executed public/private/Rust/native/checker/schema checks and fresh six-command authoring-to-native reproduction with two clean builds, two native runs and17negative controls. Distribution outcome was evidence-reviewed, not independently rerun. Two documentation precision findings corrected and independently reread before seal; no unresolved binary/runtime finding. Reviewer made no source/Kaneo/ownership changes.

## Native/operator decision and M5 evaluation

Technical native decision: ACCEPT tested exact resource load, all reachable Walk view selection and visible synthetic replacement rendering. No real creative-art approval is created or implied; isolated synthetic composition review fixtures only. Wider profile/artwork stays incomplete. Fallback observations are excluded from exact success.

M5_GATE_PACKET.md maps all five authoritative plan§6/M5 criteria to live Accepted RSF23–26 and freshRSF27 proof. M5-S PASS; M5-I PASS; M5-N PASS within the pinned isolated software-Vulkan native corridor. Overall M5 engineering milestone FULLY_ACCEPTED after this task's independent QA and accepted read-back, using the existing verification-template verdict vocabulary. Universal/reference pixel parity and production artwork completion are not claimed.

Next dependency-eligible task retrieved live: RSF-28 [M6] Optional bounded FFprobe/FFmpeg candidate-frame import, ID mdehayoorrfc43z930ij72wx, Backlog/unassigned; blocker RSF-26 Accepted. Not started.
